description: This file contains utility functions for enriching documents with normalized project IDs and updated timestamps. It provides methods to normalize various project ID formats, parse dates from different fields, and compute the most relevant update timestamp for a document.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, accepting strings, numbers, and objects with specific fields.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updatedAt date from a document by checking multiple timestamp fields and falling back to the _id timestamp if necessary.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Given a deployment-like document, returns an object with normalized projectId and computed updatedAt timestamp.
